 "text": "# Gavin Newsom Calls Trump ‘Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Big Oil’ as Iran Tensions Rattle Oil Markets: Says President’s ‘Head Is Stuck in Sand Soaked With Oil’

Gov. **Gavin Newsom** (D-CA) slammed President **Donald Trump** and the White House’s pro-fossil fuel stance amid heightened energy costs and tensions between Washington and Tehran during the ongoing war.

## Trump Is a ‘Wholly-Owned’ Subsidiary, Says Gavin Newsom

In a post on the social media platform **X** on Thursday, Newsom shared a clip of his appearance at the COP31 conference in Türkiye. “Donald Trump’s head is stuck in sand soaked with oil,” the California governor said in the post. “He’s a wholly owned subsidiary of Big Oil,” Newsom said.

He also criticized Trump’s “aggressive assaults” on climate leadership with his policies. “California will continue to dominate with a low carbon, green growth economy that can’t be held hostage by foreign wars or Big Oil’s greed,” Newsom said.

> Donald Trump's head is stuck in sand soaked with oil.\
> \
> California will continue to dominate with a low carbon, green growth economy that can't be held hostage by foreign wars or Big Oil's greed. [pic.twitter.com/xJxUyQlCcY](https://t.co/xJxUyQlCcY)
>
> — Governor Gavin Newsom (@CAgovernor) [November 12, 2026](https://x.com/CAgovernor/status/2121024060843012440?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

## GasBuddy’s Patrick De Haan Warns of Trump’s Iran Comments

Meanwhile, GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan, in a post on X, warned that Trump’s comments about no deal with Iran could be detrimental to oil. “I don’t think oil markets are going to like this,” he said.

> I don’t think oil markets are going to like this [pic.twitter.com/zB5Y0Se2xJ](https://t.co/zB5Y0Se2xJ)
>
> — Patrick De Haan (@GasBuddyGuy) [November 12, 2026](https://x.com/GasBuddyGuy/status/2120868411869712831?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

In the same thread, De Haan also warned that “after softening the tone previously in regards to escalation, this \[Trump’s comments\] certainly is not moving the needle in the right direction.”

> After softening the tone previously in regards to escalation, this certainly is not moving the needle in the right direction
>
> — Patrick De Haan (@GasBuddyGuy) [November 12, 2026](https://x.com/GasBuddyGuy/status/2120869385212416157?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Notably, Iran’s top security official, **Mohsen Rezaee**, had earlier warned the U.S. [against carrying out fresh strikes](https://www.benzinga.com/news/politics/26/11/63173398/oil-prices-rise-as-iran-threatens-us-bases-across-europe-and-middle-east-if-trump-launches-fresh-strikes-no-safe-distance-no-safe-haven-no-immunity) against Iran, saying that the move could result in lethal strikes on U.S. bases across the Middle East and Europe, which will become “legitimate targets” for Tehran.

## Oil, Gas Movement

Gas prices fell further as the American Automobile Association (AAA) [data](https://gasprices.aaa.com/) showed the national average price of gas on Thursday to \$3.9082/gallon. Diesel prices also fell on Wednesday, with the national average at \$6.0977/gallon.

At press time, the **West Texas Intermediate** (WTI) futures expiring in December were down 0.07% to \$88.68. On the other hand, **Brent** futures contracts expiring in January gained 0.50% to \$96.30 at the time of writing this article.

The **ProShares Ultra Bloomberg Crude Oil** [(NYSE:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/UCO)[UCO](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/UCO)) was down 0.37% to \$53.50 during overnight trading on Thursday. The **United States Oil Fund** [(NYSE:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/USO)[USO](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/USO)) ETF slipped 0.14% to \$145.87 during overnight trading.

## Ron DeSantis Criticizes Pro-Climate Stance

Gov. **Ron DeSantis** (R-FL) delivered sharp criticism of Democratic Party lawmakers as the GOP incurred setbacks in the midterm elections earlier this month after Former Secretary of State **John Kerry** said that voters had chosen to vote for a pro-climate stance in the midterms. DeSantis warned that [cutting oil production will not reduce costs](https://www.benzinga.com/news/politics/26/11/63174327/ron-desantis-says-stifling-oil-and-gas-production-will-not-lower-high-energy-prices-as-former-obama-official-pushes-climate-policy).

Oil companies like **Chevron Corp**. [(NYSE:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CVX)[CVX](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CVX)), **ExxonMobil Holdings Corp**. [(NYSE:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/XOM)[XOM](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/XOM)) and **ConocoPhillips** [(NYSE:](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/COP)[COP](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/COP)) saw a slight uptick in overnight trading on Thursday. CVX shares were up 0.53% to \$217.50. Meanwhile, COP shares also gained 0.16% to \$140.29. XOM was up 0.34% to \$170.35 during overnight trading.
